remarks:
Welcome to this spacious 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home located in the Genesee Valley Central School District in Belmont NY.

Offering 1,808 square feet of living space, this home provides a great layout with plenty of room for family, entertaining, and everyday living. The main level features a large kitchen that flows into a comfortable living and dining room combination creating a welcoming gathering space. Also located on the first floor is a bedroom with its own private bathroom, along with a bonus room featuring newer flooring. This flexible space could easily serve as a home office, den, playroom, or second family room. Upstairs, you'll find three additional bedrooms and a full bathroom providing plenty of space for family or guests.

Outside, the property offers a concrete driveway, a two-car garage with a workshop area in the back, and a large backyard with room for gardening, recreation, or outdoor entertaining. A garden shed provides additional storage, while the concrete patio just outside the back door offers a convenient spot to relax and enjoy the yard. Additional features include a metal roof and replacement windows offering some desirable updates. Conveniently located in Belmont and within the Genesee Valley School District, this home offers space, versatility, and a great opportunity to make it your own.  Lot size is 0.72 acres.
